-->

**Summary**

To improve InstantSearch releases reliability we plan to add some [End-2-End tests](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch-e2e-tests) in addition to our existing unit test suite.

Since we'll use the [e-commerce demo](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/tree/develop/examples/e-commerce) to run our tests then we need to update it to use the `instantsearch.js` build from the current branch.

To achieve this, this PR makes the following changes:
* Remove `instantsearch.js` from dependencies
* Alias `instantsearch.js` to use the build in the parent directory (using [Parcel aliases](https://parceljs.org/module_resolution.html#alias) and [TypeScript path mapping](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/module-resolution.html#path-mapping))
* Update `website:build` command to build `instantsearch` before the demos

comments.body: Seems good, but should we not do that for all examples? Downside is now that it won’t work standalone in csb anymore. I’d really rather have a purpose-built example for the tests

> Seems good, but should we not do that for all examples?

Mmm, I don't think we'll run some tests on them (maybe on the new media demo but it is not merged yet https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3915) but I can update them to stay consistent :slightly_smiling_face: 

> Downside is now that it won’t work standalone in csb anymore. I’d really rather have a purpose-built example for the tests

Is it a problem? I never saw these demos used in csb.
I think we agreed to use this one for now to go faster but to build some test specific demos later on.

I don't remember if we agreed to run it on the actual example. I thought the reasoning was that we should create a minimal example (e.g. no Google Fonts, no image header to speed up the page load). We could add these minimal examples in the [`e2e/` folder](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/tree/6dc0b3a2b921687f0add0decb8d17dc9888a3b7b/e2e). It's indeed nice to be able to run the example in CodeSandbox (some people asked for it already).

WDYT?

> I don't remember if we agreed to run it on the actual example. I thought the reasoning was that we should create a minimal example (e.g. no Google Fonts, no image header to speed up the page load). We could add these minimal examples in the e2e/ folder. 

Yes, but it was planned to do this in a second time since already having a running test suite on the existing examples was way faster to set up and already bring us a lot of value to improve InstantSearch reliability.

> It's indeed nice to be able to run the example in CodeSandbox (some people asked for it already).

New examples (like the e-commerce demo) are already not runnable in CodeSansbox anyway, no? Or I am missing something here?

Ok, I missed that CodeSandbox runs the parcel build.

Still not convinced that keeping this "feature" worth the hassle tho.
As we decided IRL last week, to go faster we'll use the existing demos for now and see in the future if some dedicated demos are required.
